metadata.title: Replace low-stock reporting and add exact cart quotations
metadata.body:
Replace the primitive low-stock SKU list with a validated availability report and an authenticated query/download handler. Reports include filtered availability states, replenishment recommendations, deterministic pages and all-match summaries; CSV downloads escape product text safely.

Also add a separate authenticated cart quotation operation that validates parsed input, prices each line with exact discounts and applies shipping once without reserving stock or charging payments. Existing single-item pricing and checkout placement keep their contracts; fractional prices and unsafe monetary totals reject.

Validation: Node 22.23.3 offline install and clean TypeScript build; 29 external scenarios; exact-base defect reproductions; independent full builds and relevant suites for report-only (16 scenarios) and quote-only (13 scenarios); Prettier and diff checks. No committed tests or dependencies added.
